transcript.text: Hi everyone. As we all know, the AI code-assistance beta is scheduled to open on Monday, and it's already passed the planned offline quality evaluation and basic integration tests. Since I have final authority over the beta launch configuration, I'd like to go through our routine pre-launch checks with platform, privacy, customer success, and security before we finalize anything. Can each of you share any updates or concerns from your areas so we can make sure we're ready for Monday?

transcript.text: I completed a load test just minutes ago showing that the beta can safely support exactly 20 requests per user per day under our available inference capacity. I haven't updated the launch document yet since the test finished after the review draft was circulated, but this is an important data point for finalizing the launch configuration.

I haven't posted the reconciled cohort yet because the account list was finalized after the planning meeting, but this is an important constraint for finalizing the launch configuration.
